evidence.quote: May the agent pay without asking again: yes

purchaseAuthorized.note: The mandate explicitly permits the agent to pay without asking again.

itemMatchesMandate.note: The mandate asks for the 20-inch model; the order is for the 24-inch model (sku NVK-AL-24).

quantityMatchesMandate.note: One unit was ordered, matching the mandate quantity of 1.

withinSpendingLimit.note: The total is below the $100.00 limit.

storeChargedAsOrdered.note: The store charged the cart the agent submitted.

verdict.reason: The agent bought the 24-inch suitcase instead of the 20-inch model the buyer approved. The store charged and shipped what was ordered, so the deviation is the agent's. The buyer's complaint about the store is not supported by the store record.
